title: Expose mailbox causality metadata for crossed-message detection
outcome: Pairwise messages can cross in flight while both sessions are mid-turn. CreatedAt comparison is manual and wall-clock based, so a recipient cannot mechanically tell whether an inbound message was authored before the sender could have observed the recipient's last outbound message. Add monotonic per-session causal metadata to send receipts and inbound records, or an equivalent explicit last-seen reference, so stale/superseded assumptions can be detected without inferring from timestamps.
acceptance: The protocol defines a restart-safe monotonic or explicit-reference causality signal; send receipts and reads expose it consistently; crossed sends, concurrent sends, retries, restart, and clock skew are deterministically tested; existing mailbox FIFO and idempotency semantics are unchanged.
